news.text: Lucio-Rino, It's The Night Of Reckoning#Juve-#Lazio at 8:45 PM[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"EVERYONE IS AGAINST #JUVE"#Spalletti takes on #Lazio and fires back: "They want us in the quicksand, but we are on the right track".The coach praises #Gattuso then entrenches himself in the bianconero dugout: "Me nervous? No, I have selective sympathies... Too many people only highlight the negative things: but we are getting stronger". His assistant #Domenichini will take the bench. #Nico threatens #Woltemade's spot. Ringhio wants to catch up to #Inter.[Front Page TuttoSport]

LUCIANO SPALLETTI'S PRE-MATCH PRESS CONFERENCE AHEAD OF JUVENTUS-LAZIOAhead of the clash against Lazio, Luciano Spalletti spoke to the media to preview the Bianconeri's next fixture, discussing the opposition's strengths, the team's condition following their European trip and his possible team selection.Here is what he had to say.THE CHALLENGE AGAINST LAZIO“Lazio are doing very well. They have a clear mentality and a well-defined structure, as well as some excellent individual players. I'm thinking of Frattesi's explosiveness, a player I know personally and whose all-round qualities I really appreciate: he runs, scores goals and has a huge heart. Then there are Isaksen's unpredictable moment
Matchweek 7 awaits 🤩[Serie A]

🇮🇹🆙 During the international break, #Cambiaso worked intensely with #Spalletti, focusing on tactics, athletic preparation and video analysis to better absorb the demands. The coach continues to believe in his potential and does not want to give up on him. After a complicated period, he wants to relaunch himself and return to being an important asset.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🤕🔙 "We will likely see #Boga back in the squad list: he has slightly accelerated his recovery, initially a return between late October and early November was expected. For #Ekhator, however, more time and caution will be needed because he suffered a relapse. His return is expected in November."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
#Wolte Behind #Kolo#Juve is changing#Spalletti's idea: the German giant with the Frenchman[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#WOLTE, #KOLO AND MORE CROSSES. LET'S GO, #JUVE!"Starting again with the two forwards used in Vigo. Serena: "They complement each other well. But more balls need to be crossed into the middle..." #Spalletti is starting to consider the double center-forward as an option: not just during the match. The work (including psychological) on #Cambiaso and the discovery of #Sarr: the coach is leveraging the positive aspects. Tomorrow against #Lazio, #Çelik is back. And now #Conceição is at risk...[Front Page TuttoSport]

👀🔛 #Woltemade could start against #Lazio: #Spalletti is evaluating the German in the attacking midfield with Nico #González, behind #KoloMuani, in the 3-4-2-1.[Gianluca Di Marzio via @Juventus_Reborn]

🇩🇪🔛 "The reasoning for #Adzic also applies to #Licina. It remains to be seen whether he will be a key protagonist for #Juventus 2027 or 2028: perhaps next year he will join a mid-to-lower Serie A club to play consistently and get around thirty matches as a starter, but the management has very clear ideas regarding their talents of the future."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇲🇪🆙 "#Juventus, clear ideas regarding #Adzic: he will return to Turin at the end of the season. Two Bundesliga clubs have sounded him out, declaring themselves ready to offer around €18M, but the bianconero club will not consider anything less than €25/30M and regards him as one of the protagonists of the future: barring truly sensational offers, they want to hold onto him tightly."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

💰🆙 Following their second consecutive victory in the Europa League, #Juventus has banked €15.34M so far. The figure includes €4.31M for participation, €10.05M for the Value Pillar, €900,000 for the two wins and approximately €80,000 for the minimum guaranteed league placement. Revenue can still increase based on the results in upcoming matches and their final position in the league phase.[Calcio&Finanza via @juventusinsidernews]
